title: Kotlin Examples
description: Each example belongs to one starter lesson. Follow its setup steps before trying it. These examples need the named tools and do not run in this site playground.

examples.title: Print a greeting
examples.description: main is the starting function. println prints a value on a new line.

examples.title: Keep a fixed value
examples.description: val gives a name to a value that cannot be reassigned.

examples.title: Update a variable
examples.description: var lets you assign a new value. += adds to the current number.

examples.title: Build a message
examples.description: A dollar sign places a variable value inside a Kotlin string.

examples.title: Choose a value
examples.description: if can return a value. Both branches below produce a message.

examples.title: Read a list
examples.description: listOf makes a read-only list. The first item has index zero.

examples.title: Count with a range
examples.description: The range 1..3 includes both ends. for reads each number.

examples.title: Write a short function
examples.description: A function gives steps a name. This expression body returns n times two.

examples.title: Handle no value
examples.description: A question mark makes a type nullable. ?: supplies a fallback for null.

examples.title: Read safely
examples.description: ?. only calls a property or method when the value is not null.

examples.title: Keep related data
examples.description: A data class stores fields and supplies useful data operations such as copy.

examples.title: Match a choice
examples.description: when picks a branch for a value. else handles the values not listed.
